description: Builds deterministic stratified review packets and evaluates independently supplied labels without changing entity-resolution decisions.
sampling: Deterministic minimum SHA-256 priority within automatic-site, automatic-establishment, and review-candidate strata.
precision_gate: Each automatic stratum requires all 425 labels submitted, at least 384 conclusive labels, no more than 10% exclusions, and a 95% Wilson lower bound of at least 0.99.
retry: Rerun deterministically from the same immutable resolution and registry pointers; no partial sample is published.
checkpoint: Run-scoped sample artifacts remain staged until all strata and hashes verify.
idempotency: The configured seed, source release hashes, and minimum SHA-256 priority rule produce the same review sample.
retention_profile: Keep review packets and labels local; publish aggregate metrics only after privacy and contributing-source policy review.
cancellation: Stop after the current partition; no current pointer changes until the complete sample passes verification.
